title: Delicate Nabemono Bean Stew
description: A light and flavorful Japanese-inspired stew made with delicate ingredients and a variety of beans. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and ginger to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the kidney beans and Nabemono to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions.
